news.label: Genie 4 rolls out to the public
details: It began rolling out on November 18 to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers.
While exploring, you can change the weather, characters and environment just by describing it.
A Project Genie agent that builds worlds from conversation was also added, along with a gallery for sharing and remixing.

lines.say: First up, Google. Genie four is now rolling out to eligible users.
lines.show: First up, Google. Genie 4 is now rolling out to eligible users.

lines.say: You can walk around a generated world while changing the weather and characters with your words.
lines.show: You can explore a generated world while changing the weather and characters with words.

lines.say: I love that even the sound and dialogue are created in real time.
lines.show: Even the sound and dialogue are created in real time. Pretty cool!

link.title: Genie 4 is now available
link.description: We are rolling out a new Project Genie experience to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers, opening access to our new Genie 4 world model.

news.label: AnyLab: AI 3D model generation
details: It can generate 3D models from text or reference images, and it was shown at Formnext 2026.
The plan is to cover printability checks, orientation and support optimization, and sending print jobs. Some parts are still in development.
They're also working on adjusting existing 3D models for multicolor printing and making them easier to use as 3MF data.

lines.say: Next, a story about three D printers.
Anycubic showed off AnyLab, a tool that makes three D models with AI.
lines.show: Anycubic showed off AnyLab, a tool that makes 3D models with AI.

lines.say: It can build models from text or images, and the plan is to connect it all the way to print preparation.
lines.show: It builds models from text or images, with plans to connect to print preparation.

news.label: Studio3D is now available
points: Everything runs on your own PC
Send models to and from Blender
details: It bundles part splitting, retopology, UVs, material setup and export into one tool.
Processing runs entirely on a PC with an NVIDIA GPU. The VRAM you need ranges from 6 to 32 gigabytes, depending on the model.
An add-on lets you send models to and from Blender. It's offered through licensing or as contract production work.

lines.say: It turns images into three D models and finishes the job right on your computer.
lines.show: It turns images into 3D models and finishes the job right on your computer.

news.label: Generating training data with Cosmos
points: Defect images of circuit boards too
details: A guide was released on using an AI coding agent to run Cosmos Data Factory and generate training data.
It can change the weather in videos, create rare accident scenes, and produce defect images for inspection.
From normal images and 3D assets, it can build training data that mimics misaligned parts and bad solder joints.

lines.say: Now to robotics. NVIDIA has published a guide to making training data with Cosmos.
lines.show: Now to robotics. NVIDIA has published a guide to making training data with Cosmos.

lines.say: The fun part is that it can even create defect images of electronic circuit boards.
lines.show: It can even create defect images of electronic circuit boards.

link.title: Build Training-Ready Physical AI Datasets with Two Prompts in NVIDIA Cosmos | NVIDIA Technical Blog
link.description: World model accuracy starts with high-quality, diverse training datasets. Yet capturing rare defects, nighttime incidents, and other challenging scenarios is costly and time-consuming.

news.label: Stitch Loop announced
details: It's an experimental agent that connects your codebase and operational data to keep improving software that's already live.
It analyzes GitHub, logs and behavior data to suggest improvements, then fixes the code in an isolated environment and creates a pull request.
Early features focus on security, speed and accessibility. It's currently accepting sign-ups through a waitlist.

link.title: Introducing Stitch Loop: A new way to build and evolve products
link.description: Stitch Loop is an always-on product agent from Google Labs that works non-stop to help lean teams build better products.
